saw_lines: Councils do not buy software on impulse. They shortlist one platform, get it approved, then renew it for years.
So the sale is decided by who a council remembers from its first search, long before a demo is booked.
Your 9 Google text ads read like code errors, and the latest was shown November 7, 2024. Write three new ones on incident reporting and link them to the try the app page.
